description: Use this for opening hours, entry fees (adult and child), extra tickets, suggested visit time and the nearest station with walking minutes of a temple, shrine or sight in Kamakura and Enoshima: the Great Buddha (Kotoku-in), Hasedera, Hokokuji bamboo temple, Meigetsu-in, Engakuji, Kenchoji, Tsurugaoka Hachimangu, Zeniarai Benzaiten, Enoshima Shrine, the Sea Candle, the Iwaya caves, Enoshima Aquarium and more. Names are matched loosely ("bamboo temple", "daibutsu"). Without a name it lists the sights, optionally for one area. Examples: "What are the opening hours and entry fee of the Great Buddha?" / "How do I get to the bamboo temple in Kamakura and what does it cost?"

area.description: List mode: only sights in this area (kita = Kita-Kamakura; center = Kamakura Station and the shrine; east = East valleys; west = West hills; hase = Hase; coast = Enoden coast; enoshima = Enoshima).

month.description: Month of the visit, for seasonal opening hours.

name.description: Temple, shrine, sight or station, in any common spelling.
